Happy Birthday, Bangaram

to my best friend, and my family

I made this for you, with all the things I feel but never say out loud.

How we found each other

It started with nothing special. That’s what makes it so special to me.

  • Two campuses

    You were from another campus. We were living in separate worlds and had no idea.

  • One exam hall

    Then an exam hall put us in the same room. Two nervous strangers, and the start of everything.

  • Slowly, a friendship

    Not in a day. A little more trust each time, a little less distance, until it was simply there.

  • Best friend

    Somewhere along the way, “friend” stopped being a big enough word.

  • Family

    And now you’re family. The kind I didn’t have to be born into, just lucky enough to find.

Three things I don’t say enough

Thank you

For staying. For understanding more than I ever explain. For being someone I never have to pretend around.

I’m proud of you

For who you are and who you’re becoming, even on the days you can’t see it yourself.

I love you

Not loudly. In the quiet, permanent way that family does.

Twenty little memories

Every one of these is a piece of my heart. Tap a photo to see it bigger.

A letter, just for you

Bangaram,

I’ve been trying to write this for days, and every version sounded smaller than what I feel. So I’m just going to say it plainly.

We met in an exam hall. Different campuses, different worlds, two people worried about the same paper. If someone had told me that day that you’d become one of the most important people in my life, I wouldn’t have believed them.

But it happened slowly, the way the best things do. A little more trust every time. A little less distance. Until one day I looked up and realised you weren’t “a friend from another campus” anymore. You were my best friend.

And then you became more than that. You became my family.

Family isn’t about blood. It’s about who you’d want next to you on your best day and on your worst one. For me, it’s you. Both days. Always you.

I don’t say it often enough, so I’m saying it here, where you can come back and read it whenever you want: thank you. Thank you for being exactly who you are. I’m so lucky life put me in that exam hall.

I love you, Bangaram. Happy birthday. I’m not going anywhere.

Your best friend 🤍

What I promise you

  • I’ll be there on the days you need someone, even when you don’t say it.
  • I’ll cheer for you louder than you cheer for yourself.
  • I’ll tell you the truth, but always gently.
  • I’ll remember the little things, because they’re the big things.
  • I’ll never let distance decide what we are.
  • I’ll be your family, always.

Send a wish to the sky

Close your eyes, think of something you want this year, and let it go.

Happy Birthday, Bangaram

Whatever this year brings, I hope it’s as kind to you as you are to everyone who loves you. And I hope I get to be there for every bit of it.

Forever yours, your best friend 🤍
